proves.claim: tierOverruns returns exactly the manifest rows over their tier limit with per-tier counts, and lists files with no recorded time apart as unmeasured.

gate.io-test-scripts-tier-overruns.lists.why: A file with no time is unknown, not slow; counting it as over would send builders after files nobody measured.

proves.claim: The report prints one line per over-limit file and the tier count line and exits 0, and with no time record prints no file times recorded and exits 1.

gate.io-test-scripts-tier-overruns.repor.why: The measure item reads this output, so its lines and exit codes must be fixed by a case.
